description: This file defines the Heading plugin class for CKEditor 5 integration within Drupal, including configuration management, form building, and plugin element handling.

classes.name: Heading
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for CKEditor 5 heading management, including configuration, form building, and element filtering.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the default configuration array for the plugin.

methods.name: validChoices
methods.description: Computes and returns valid heading options excluding always enabled headings.

methods.name: getEnabledHeadings
methods.description: Retrieves all enabled headings, including always enabled ones.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for selecting enabled headings.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the configuration form input.

methods.name: generateCheckboxForHeadingOption
methods.description: Creates a checkbox render array for a heading option.

methods.name: getDynamicPluginConfig
methods.description: Filters plugin configuration based on enabled headings.

methods.name: getElementsSubset
methods.description: Returns the subset of elements based on enabled headings.

methods.name: enabledHeadingsToTags
methods.description: Converts enabled headings to corresponding HTML tags.
